name: Paradise PD
description: An eager young rookie joins the ragtag small-town police force led by his dad as they bumble, squabble and snort their way through a big drug case.

videos.title: Welcome to Paradise
videos.overview: At 18, Kevin Crawford finally gets a shot at joining the police force run by his dad, just as a new drug dubbed "argyle meth" hits the streets.

videos.title: Ass on the Line
videos.overview: Bullet finds fame and glory in an underground dogfighting ring, and Chief Crawford butts heads with his biggest rival on a maddening homicide case.

videos.title: Black & Blue
videos.overview: At Gina's insistence, Fitz starts carrying a gun -- and ignites a national media scandal. Shipped off to a nursing home, Hopson uncovers a conspiracy.

videos.title: Karla
videos.overview: When Kevin's mom buys him a sleek new talking police car, it's love at first sight. Bullet turns Dusty into a fried-chicken kingpin.

videos.title: Dungeons & Dragnet
videos.overview: When Preacher Paul ropes the cops into his war against a "satanic cult" of D&D players, Bullet makes a move on the preacher's virtuous daughter.

videos.title: Meet the Jabowskis
videos.overview: After finding a clue to her past, Gina sets out on a quest for revenge and bonds with her long-lost family -- leaving Paradise without a tough cop.

videos.title: Police Academy
videos.overview: While Kevin and his dad face off in the police academy Coptathalon, Bullet runs the station and Dusty helps Hopson take care of unfinished business.

videos.title: Task Force
videos.overview: The hunt for the argyle meth mastermind leads Kevin and his task force to the circus. A cash-strapped Dusty auctions off his virginity on the dark web.

videos.title: Parent Trap
videos.overview: Kevin's plan to reunite his family backfires in a big way. After seeing his DNA test results, Dusty vows to stop the town's Thanksgiving parade.

videos.title: Christmas in Paradise
videos.overview: As Dusty scrambles to get Paradise ready for a visit from Santa, Kevin races to root out the traitor on the force.

videos.title: Paradise Found
videos.overview: As tourists flock to the new, peaceful Paradise, Gina plots to bust Dusty out of prison, Kevin savors his hero status, and Karen plans an execution.

videos.title: Big Ball Energy
videos.overview: On Kevin Sucks Day, Fitz hunts down a new meth supplier, the chief discovers Karen's secret fetish, and Kevin vows to defy an embarrassing prediction.

videos.title: Tucker Carlson Is a Huge D**k
videos.overview: A rant by Tucker Carlson sparks a war of the sexes, leaving Paradise with two police forces. Fitz's new evil plan is thwarted by Gal-Qaeda.

videos.title: Who Ate Wally's Waffles
videos.overview: Dusty finds a long-lost sitcom star living in Paradise and sets out to reboot his career. The squad obsesses over Kevin's bathroom habits.

videos.title: The Father, the Son and the Post-it Note
videos.overview: With crime at an all-time high, Chief Crawford decides to steal the Kingpin case back from Agent Clappers. Fitz runs into major money trouble.

videos.title: Flip the Vote
videos.overview: Desperate to win reelection, Karen legalizes meth — inspiring Fitz to run against her. The chief recruits Dobby for a mission. Bullet visits hell.

videos.title: Paradise PD Meets Brickleberry
videos.overview: Fleeing Paradise, the gang crosses over into Brickleberry National Park, just in time to help Ranger Woody and crew hunt for missing bear Malloy.

videos.title: Operation DD
videos.overview: After learning that Fitz isn't quite what he seems, the squad races to stop their real enemy — and save Paradise from a nuclear disaster.

videos.title: Fallout
videos.overview: Chief Crawford develops an unlikely, unhealthy and unholy friendship. Delbert and Robby form a new country. Fitz adjusts to married life.

videos.title: Top Cops
videos.overview: Paradise PD juices its arrest stats in order to win a cop contest. Fitz gets a new identity. Dusty terrorizes a father-son doughnut shop.

videos.title: Ice Ice Babies
videos.overview: Chief wants another kid, but he must prove to Karen that his dad skills have improved. Robby opens a carnival. Dusty turns the screws on Fitz.

videos.title: Trigger Warning
videos.overview: Does the town of Paradise have a gun problem? Depends on who you ask. Also, Dusty bribes Bullet to appear in his online videos.

videos.title: Showdown at the O-bese Corral
videos.overview: Dusty inspires a revolution at Weight Watchers. Bullet worries Gina may have an addiction. Fitz's wife lands a job at SeaWorld.

videos.title: How the Cookie Crumbles
videos.overview: Dusty gives Fitz a new identity: "Family Feud" host Steve Harvey. Meanwhile, Chief Crawford tries stealing his own sperm from a fertility clinic.

videos.title: Blind Drunk
videos.overview: Lovelorn Kevin invents an imaginary girlfriend in hopes of making Gina jealous. Chief Crawford learns the town never repealed Prohibition.

videos.title: Blimp City
videos.overview: Paradise PD combats the city's drone menace. Karen's mother, Agatha, moves in to help with baby prep. Kevin offers to assist Gina with her tech issues.

videos.title: The World According to LARP
videos.overview: Karen asks Chief to play nice with Hopson, but the task proves surprisingly humiliating. Kevin tries to get Gina into Live Action Role Playing.

videos.title: Fetal Attraction
videos.overview: The mutants enter stage three in their quest for revenge. Gina's family kidnaps Kevin. The Chief worries his unborn child has it in for him.

videos.title: What Happens in Twatemala
videos.overview: Karen bets big, hoping a new casino will raise enough money to rebuild Paradise. Kevin's relationship with Gina remains stubbornly platonic.

videos.title: PARAD-ISIS
videos.overview: Gina and Kevin make a big announcement, Bullet worries Fitz is on the verge of an unpleasant discovery, and Dusty joins a "gym."

videos.title: The Brozone Lair
videos.overview: Excited to finally have the son he always wanted, Chief Crawford focuses on being a new father while the townspeople build a utopia — inside Dobby.

videos.title: Diddy's Home
videos.overview: Karen replaces everyone in town with actors to impress Elon Musk, Kevin gets an inflatable girlfriend and Dusty obsesses about impressing his father.

videos.title: A Star Is Porn
videos.overview: Inspired by his son's interest in a kids' band, Chief Crawford decides to pursue his artistic ambition. Kevin accidentally becomes an adult film star.

videos.title: Good Jeans
videos.overview: A billionaire moves his company to Paradise, forcing Robby and Delbert to get jobs. Chief Crawford searches for the perfect outfit to impress Charles.

videos.title: The Shartist
videos.overview: When Gina returns to town, Kevin tries to prove she's a clone. Dusty becomes an art sensation and Chief Crawford falls prey to his virtual assistant.

videos.title: The Butt Cut
videos.overview: To undo a family curse, Chief Crawford must cater to the whim of a witch living on the outskirts of town. Kevin looks for dirt on Charles Lovely.

videos.title: Boat!
videos.overview: Kevin tries to sneak back into Paradise to warn his friends of Charles' evil plan while they take jobs selling Lovely Corp. products door-to-door.

videos.title: King of the Norf
videos.overview: The resistance plots to take down Lovely Corp. Karen mixes up her medication, causing mayhem. Chief Crawford and Fitz struggle to move Dusty's mother.

videos.title: Sack to the Future
videos.overview: Determined to change his life, Kevin journeys back in time to undo a childhood mistake — but meddling with the past doesn't solve his problems.

videos.title: The Eternal Reckoning
videos.overview: With the town suspended in the air, everyone rallies together to defeat Charles Lovely before it's too late. Dusty plans a family reunion.
